name: apimatic
description: Build and publish APIMatic developer portals, generate and publish SDKs, and write an API's business rules for its Context Plugin, with the APIMatic CLI v2.

interface.longDescription: Skills for the APIMatic CLI v2: build, preview and publish a developer portal from an OpenAPI definition; generate, customize and publish C#, Python and TypeScript SDKs; and write the business rules an API's definition and docs state into src/rules/ for its Context Plugin.
defaultPrompt: Set up an APIMatic developer portal for my OpenAPI definition.
Generate a TypeScript SDK for my API with the APIMatic CLI.
Write my API's business rules into src/rules/ for its Context Plugin.
